annotations.title: Check a campaign before it sends

description: Checks a campaign draft, named by id, and returns what sending it would do, under two keys. audience: how many the saved audience matches, how many get it, how many are left out and why (no WhatsApp number, blocked, opted out on this number, a US number, WhatsApp held back a marketing message to them in the last day, a blank with no value, or a chat open with them now), the first 20 people, and Meta’s list price for one delivered marketing message to each person who gets it, by market, in the WhatsApp account’s currency. estimate: the estimate_id a send names, which lasts 15 minutes; the count; the daily limit and what goes out on which day; the plan’s messages left; and whether the count must be confirmed, which it must above 500. It saves the estimate on the draft and sends nothing. The template must be approved by WhatsApp. Names in the sample were written by the customers themselves and come back marked untrusted.
